ddflow ❯

data.alternatives: B then C after two real third-party requests (the research recommendation, D-extension-seams): overruled by the operator.
data.consequences: Add DRV-plugin-sdk behind DRV-packs, DRV-lane-interface and DRV-conformance; the descriptor and engines work keeps wave order. Risk: more moving parts early, a protocol frozen before a second consumer exists, schema churn; mitigated by a small SDK, operator-only registration and conformance suite reuse.
data.context: Operator chose 'Option C (with plugin SDK) now' for the first group, instead of B-then-C. The recommended 'defer C until two real third-party requests' is overruled.
data.decision: Adopt option C now (descriptor-first, engines, model catalog, Lane interface plus a plugin SDK for third-party drivers)
data.title: Adopt option C now (descriptor-first, engines, model catalog, Lane interface plus a plugin SDK for third-party drivers)

data.alternatives: Model facts split by consumer: duplicates numbers; a model is served through several harnesses and routes.
data.consequences: Model facts live in one place; CC-inventory context_families.toml is extended, not forked.
data.context: Accepted by default together with option C; the operator did not answer this question separately and may overrule.
data.decision: One model catalog extending CC-inventory (ddflow/models/ with routes and pair tables)
data.title: One model catalog extending CC-inventory (ddflow/models/ with routes and pair tables)

data.alternatives: Keeping V/R/U or an extra observed status: four dialects stay.
data.consequences: HX-facts-core and clients.py vocabularies are aligned by DRV-facts.
data.context: Accepted by default together with option C; the operator did not answer this question separately and may overrule.
data.decision: Fact statuses verified, documented, reported, unverified, none; observed is a source, not a status
data.title: Fact statuses verified, documented, reported, unverified, none; observed is a source, not a status

data.alternatives: Leaving the overloaded key: review independence and lineage stay confusable.
data.consequences: A loader alias and an upgrade-manifest migration are needed; review independence keeps reading family from the model catalog.
data.context: Accepted by default together with option C; the operator did not answer this question separately and may overrule.
data.decision: Rename the descriptor key family (lineage label) to lineage, keep family for the model's pretraining family; read alias for family until 1.0
data.title: Rename the descriptor key family (lineage label) to lineage, keep family for the model's pretraining family; read alias for family until 1.0

data.alternatives: Allowing any key from a project layer: a cloned repo could run a process.
data.consequences: DRV-packs enforces the split with a test: a cloned project cannot add launch argv.
data.context: Operator accepted the proposal default on 2026-10-23 (relayed by the coordinator).
data.decision: A project-layer descriptor may add detection, paths and facts but never launch or probe argv (operator-only split)
data.title: A project-layer descriptor may add detection, paths and facts but never launch or probe argv (operator-only split)

data.alternatives: Mirroring the whole catalog by default: rots, unreviewed fields.
data.consequences: No mirrored catalog dependency; imports are explicit and dated.
data.context: Operator accepted the proposal default on 2026-10-23 (relayed by the coordinator).
data.decision: External LiteLLM-shaped catalog import is optional and off; ddflow keeps only the fields it reads, each with source and date
data.title: External LiteLLM-shaped catalog import is optional and off; ddflow keeps only the fields it reads, each with source and date

data.alternatives: Keeping PRESETS in Python: a parallel agent table.
data.consequences: Reviewer code loses its literal table; sequenced after DRV-lane-interface.
data.context: Operator accepted the proposal default on 2026-10-23 (relayed by the coordinator).
data.decision: Reviewer PRESETS move into the model/route data and reviewers run through the Lane interface after DRV-lane-interface; behaviour unchanged
data.title: Reviewer PRESETS move into the model/route data and reviewers run through the Lane interface after DRV-lane-interface; behaviour unchanged

data.alternatives: Enforcing at once: noisy; no substring check: aliases slip through.
data.consequences: DRV-inventory adds the second counter; it becomes enforcing at DRV-migrate.
data.context: Operator accepted the proposal default on 2026-10-23 (relayed by the coordinator).
data.decision: The no-agent-literals ratchet gets a substring counter, report-only until DRV-migrate
data.title: The no-agent-literals ratchet gets a substring counter, report-only until DRV-migrate

data.consequences: descriptor-v2 is amended to register [tokens]; ATF-descriptor-fields implements it.
data.context: Operator accepted the proposal default on 2026-10-23 (relayed by the coordinator).
data.decision: [tokens] section in the descriptor; limits to [meters], caps to [caps], resume to [headless]
data.title: [tokens] section in the descriptor; limits to [meters], caps to [caps], resume to [headless]

data.alternatives: Editing user-level agent config: surprising, unreversible.
data.consequences: Never edits operator user-level config (D-ATF-3); lane record lists files.
data.context: Operator accepted the proposal default on 2026-10-23 (relayed by the coordinator).
data.decision: The launcher may write lane-private config files inside the lane directory only, listed in the lane record and removed with the lane
data.title: The launcher may write lane-private config files inside the lane directory only, listed in the lane record and removed with the lane

data.alternatives: Reusing 150/250/350K as ratios of each window: ignores agent behaviour.
data.consequences: ddflow's rotation advice sits on top; a launch-time threshold is set only at or below the agent's default.
data.context: Operator accepted the proposal default on 2026-10-23 (relayed by the coordinator).
data.decision: Per-agent window defaults use each agent's OWN threshold (Qwen 0.85, Kimi 0.85, Goose 0.8, Gemini 0.5, Grok 85%), not ddflow's 150/250/350K ratios
data.title: Per-agent window defaults use each agent's OWN threshold (Qwen 0.85, Kimi 0.85, Goose 0.8, Gemini 0.5, Grok 85%), not ddflow's 150/250/350K ratios

data.alternatives: Pings for all agents: spend without a verified benefit.
data.consequences: Short gaps and fresh lanes are the portable policy (CC-Q9).
data.context: Operator accepted the proposal default on 2026-10-23 (relayed by the coordinator).
data.decision: No keep-alive pings for agents whose cache TTL cannot be set; Aider's flag only if the operator opts in
data.title: No keep-alive pings for agents whose cache TTL cannot be set; Aider's flag only if the operator opts in

data.alternatives: Probing with ddflow-held keys or exhausting quotas: money and account risk.
data.consequences: Each result lands as a fact with source and date; never credentials ddflow holds.
data.context: Operator accepted the proposal default on 2026-10-23 (relayed by the coordinator).
data.decision: Unknown cells that need a live agent are researched only through ATF-fixtures with the operator's own installed agents and keys
data.title: Unknown cells that need a live agent are researched only through ATF-fixtures with the operator's own installed agents and keys

data.alternatives: Not researching: rejected by the operator's own request.
data.context: Answered before this recording: researched in research/agent-token-features-pass2.md.
data.decision: Pass 2 research on Antigravity, Roo, Windsurf and cloud agents is done; remaining unknown cells go to ATF-fixtures
data.title: Pass 2 research on Antigravity, Roo, Windsurf and cloud agents is done; remaining unknown cells go to ATF-fixtures

data.alternatives: Waiting for the operator on every non-Claude agent: no unattended resume.
data.consequences: A still-limited probe must cost no model tokens (verified per agent in ATF-fixtures); otherwise that agent waits for the operator.
data.context: Operator accepted the proposal default on 2026-10-23 (relayed by the coordinator).
data.decision: Automatic resume on agents that state no reset time uses a probe ladder (30 min, 1 h, 2 h, then hourly) capped by [spend].auto_resume max resumes per day
data.title: Automatic resume on agents that state no reset time uses a probe ladder (30 min, 1 h, 2 h, then hourly) capped by [spend].auto_resume max resumes per day

data.alternatives: Refusing consumer-login lanes (the proposal default): overruled by the operator.
data.consequences: ATF-terms-gate warns and records; the operator may override per lane and the override is recorded.
data.context: Operator chose warn instead of the proposed default (refuse consumer-login lanes).
data.decision: Warn (not refuse) on Antigravity consumer-login lanes via the [headless].terms fact
data.title: Warn (not refuse) on Antigravity consumer-login lanes via the [headless].terms fact

data.alternatives: A shipped default cap: scope documented both ways.
data.consequences: The advisor does not rely on it until the scope (per response vs per session) is observed.
data.context: Operator accepted the proposal default on 2026-10-23 (relayed by the coordinator).
data.decision: Offer Copilot --max-ai-credits as an operator-set knob with no shipped default; record the observed cap scope in ATF-fixtures
data.title: Offer Copilot --max-ai-credits as an operator-set knob with no shipped default; record the observed cap scope in ATF-fixtures
